question: How stable is the observed time ratio across the fixed mixture of enrolled sources?
analysis: Use every recorded request and retain the two policies' paired timings. Keep all questions from each human table, package, schedule session or retained table together. Sample whole entities with replacement inside each of those four strata, preserving the original number in each stratum. Compute the ratio of summed Base to summed loop end-to-end time and first-token wait for 20,000 draws, seed 427723. Report 2.5% and 97.5% percentiles. The primary decision, class mix and runtime order are unchanged; this measures source variation only.
